name: aegis
description: Air-gapped local LLM deployment CLI with Ink, FastAPI, ChromaDB, and Ollama.

scripts.install:cli: npm unlink -g @aegis/cli --silent || true && npm run build --workspace aegis && npm link --workspace aegis
scripts.uninstall:cli: npm unlink -g aegis && npm unlink -g @aegis/cli --silent || true
